lens: Geometry and proportion first, then materials and colour, then lighting on the seats, then artefacts. Measured with PIL/numpy: Otsu light fraction, cluster-mean hex, luminance L10/L50/L90 on matched crops of q15-q18 against y_47300/01/02/03/05/06, plus studio e1-e9 against sans_20/22 and the r8 renders. Crops are in /tmp/claude-0/raterB9/.

priorIssues.issue: w8a-1 / w8b-6 diamond fabric: wallpaper of solid diamonds, figure and ground inverted
priorIssues.evidence: q15 seat 1, box 50,380-230,480: light fraction 0.46 (r8 0.45) against 0.10 (y_47302 mid) and 0.18 (y_47306 left). The light-cluster mean is #454f7b, against #9baacd and #acc0ea in the photos. L90/L50 is 1.39 (r8 1.52), against 1.64-1.70. The figures now chain tip to tip and are punched with holes, so the navy ground has shrunk to a thin net of lines and the pale diamonds are no longer legible. It reads as quilted mesh (e1_dia.png against p02_dia.png / p06_dia.png). The photos show separate, fairly solid pale stepped diamonds about 5-7 cm across on a dominant mottled navy ground.

priorIssues.issue: w8a-2 / w8b-1 dash mosaic too dark and flat at row distance
priorIssues.evidence: q15 seat 2: L50 went from 46 to 56 (target 60-65; y_47306 right 61). Light/dark luminance went from 2.0 to about 2.2 (#506599 / #222d57), against 2.75 in y_47306 (#6e7eac / #21305f). It is no longer the darkest fabric. However, the 6 % 'sparse' cells are almost empty, so the dashes clump into round blobs on a diagonal checker, which reads as camouflage or leopard print (r15_mosaic.png, t_mos.png). The photo has dashes almost everywhere (p06_mos.png), with only a mild density change between rectangular cells stacked in columns.

priorIssues.issue: w8b-2 / w8a-8 headrest cover a rigid tablet
priorIssues.evidence: The cover is now a loft bowed 4 mm with a thin bent fold strip and a stitch line. At q16 the foreground cover (r16_fg.png) no longer shows a 2-3 cm slab. It is still optically dead flat: L90/L50 is 1.11 at q15 and 1.42 at q16, against 1.6 (y_47300) and 2.7 (y_47301 fg). There is no sheen along the fold or the lower half. Colour #373e57 against #3d4566 (y_47300) and #3d4260 (y_47301): close.

priorIssues.issue: w8b-3 / w8a-5 seat pocket a rigid black grid; card header only
priorIssues.evidence: e6 (e6_cmp.png): there are now two pouches, and the card shows a white half with 5 grey pictogram squares under a purple header, so the card is fixed. But the pleated hems sit at y 0.084, behind the flap that ends at about 0.08, so they are hidden. The mesh is still a coarse grid with cells of about 2 cm, against a fine net in sans_20. The new centre strap is light grey #8a8d94, but in sans_20 it is a dark charcoal tab between dark-grey ruched hems.

priorIssues.issue: w8b-4 white shell cap on the back top too thick
priorIssues.evidence: The RS cap depth changed from 0.10 to 0.092 and from 0.06 to 0.058 m. e9 / q18 look unchanged to the eye, and from behind the cap is still a fat rounded white bolster.
q15 seat 4 measures L50 43 / L90 97, light 0.17, light/dark #57698f / #1f2a56. y_47300 seat 4 measures L50 46 / L90 88, light 0.17, #57648b / #1d2b51. Essentially identical.

Fleck backs now get mosaic pads, citing y_47300. In my 4x crop of y_47300 seat 4 (p00_pads.png), the pad wings show a fine speckle and no horizontal dashes, so this looks like fleck rather than mosaic. The w6 comment in the code said the same thing ('fleck backs keep fleck pads (y_47300 seats 2/4)'). At q15, seat 4's wings now show bold horizontal dashes (r9 pad wing on a mosaic seat: light 0.42 L90 121).

priorIssues.issue: w8b-8 cover hangs as a separate card from the side
priorIssues.evidence: In e3 (e3_cmp.png) the cover still appears as two grey sliver lines standing off the pad wing. It does not wrap the pad top as one sheet.

priorIssues.issue: w8a-3 armrest box with knuckle block
priorIssues.evidence: The knuckle block is gone and there is a slim raked blade post (e7). The shape now matches the long flat pad of y_47303 reasonably well.
e4b / e7 show a rounded-rectangle puff. In y_47300 (p00_pil.png) every pillow has 4 pointed corners, a concave top edge with a centre dip, and a vertical centre crease.
The bezel is now #24232b r 0.12. At q18 it still reads as near-black with no visible gloss gradient. The bottom bezel is about 7 % of the bezel height, against about 11 % in y_47305.
q15 still shows seat backs from a high, close camera with no pans, pillows or armrests in view. y_47300 is taken from about seated head height, 1.5 rows further back.

details.refs: y_47300 seat 3 (p00_tick3.png), y_47306 mid, y_47302 right. q15 seat 3: L50 66, light 0.45, against y_47300 seat 3 L50 51, light 0.16. The render reads as dense light 'rain'; the photo has distinct columns of short ticks with dark vertical channels between them.
y_47306 left, y_47302 mid: figure and ground inverted, low contrast, figures lost to holes
y_47300 seat 4: statistics match within 3 L. The flecks are slightly larger and whiter up close (q16 fg) than the small star-shaped flecks in y_47300.
y_47306 right, y_47300 seat 3 pan: brightness is closer now, but the pattern clumps into blobs
The q15 front row shows all four weaves side by side; y_47300 / 47301 are mostly tick with some fleck, and mosaic mainly on pans and pads. Fleck seats get mosaic pads, which y_47300 does not support.
y_47306, y_47301 fg: pad shape and cover width are right (0.69 of the pad, against 0.60-0.73). The cover has no sheen, and from the side it is a separate card.
y_47300: no pointed corners or centre dip
y_47303 teal-blue webbing and buckles match
y_47302 / 47303: tick pans read slightly too bright and busy in the studio (L90/L50 1.47, against 1.7-2.75 in the photos; studio light, so unconfirmed)
y_47305, sans_22: the cap is still a fat bolster, and the hood's lower face is a large flat white slab
y_47305: proportions OK; the bezel is too black and the bottom bezel too thin
sans_20: card fixed; the mesh is coarse, the hems are hidden and the strap is the wrong tone
y_47302 / 47304: ribbed pedals and hangers OK; the IFE box is a plain black block
q15 / q16 back rows: covers and pads read correctly

issues.title: Diamond fabric overcorrected: chained, holed, low-contrast figures swamp the navy ground (inverted figure and ground; diamonds illegible)
issues.evidence: q15 light 0.46 against 0.10-0.18. Light mean #454f7b against #9baacd / #acc0ea. L90/L50 1.39 against 1.64-1.70 (e1_dia.png against p02_dia.png, p06_dia.png).
issues.fix: test/make_swatches.py y_diamond(): drop the 35 % hole punch (line 242). Set hd = rng.uniform(0.022, 0.03), so the figures are about 5-6 cm across with 2-3 cm of navy between tips. Drop 30 % of the sites instead of 25 %. Raise lift to about [3.0, 3.0, 2.6] with a mottle of 0.85-1.0 inside the figures. Move the value-noise mottle onto the ground instead: (tm + 0.4*(t-tm)) * (0.85 + 0.3*_blur_wrap(rng.random((n,n)),1.5)). Target in q15: Otsu light 0.15-0.22 and light/dark 2.2 or more.

issues.title: Dash mosaic clumps into blobs on a diagonal checker (sparse cells nearly empty)
issues.evidence: The 6 % sparse cells against 42 % dense cells give isolated blob clusters in q15 seat 2 and in the tile (t_mos.png). y_47306 right (p06_mos.png) has dashes over the whole area, with a modest dense/sparse change in cells stacked in vertical columns. Light/dark 2.2 against 2.75.
issues.fix: y_mosaic(): dens = 0.50 / 0.28 instead of 0.42 / 0.06, and offset alternate columns by half a cell instead of a pure (i+j)%2 checker (vertical bands, not diagonals). Keep 2 px dashes, but use pitch 2.2 mm and lengths 5-14 mm. Lift [6.0, 6.2, 5.6]. Target q15 L50 about 60, light 0.30-0.35.

issues.title: Tick weave too light and too densely streaked; the dark vertical channels are missing
issues.evidence: q15 seat 3: L50 66, light 0.45, light/dark #536287 / #1f2d5c. y_47300 seat 3: L50 51, light 0.16, #64729c / #22305a. The photo has columns of short ticks about 1.2-1.5 cm apart separated by clear navy channels; the render reads as uniform rain.
issues.fix: 09_seats.js yFabric: base #5a6587 -> about #4f5a7c. In make_swatches y_tick (or LAYER_PARAMS for yJacq), mask the ticks to columns: multiply the tick mask by (0.5 + 0.5*cos(2*pi*x/13 mm)) > 0.35, so dark channels about 4 mm wide separate the tick columns. Target L50 52-56, light 0.2-0.3.

issues.title: Fleck backs given mosaic pads; y_47300 shows finely speckled (fleck) pads
issues.evidence: p00_pads.png (y_47300 seat 4 at 4x): fine speckle with no horizontal dashes. The w6 code comment cited the same photo for fleck pads. In y_47306 the middle (tick) seat has confetti pads.
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js HF (and econUnitFar): F === yFabricD ? SEATMAT.yHead : ... (fleck back -> confetti pad yHead, as before w8).

issues.title: Pillow is still a rounded puff with no pointed corners or centre dip
issues.evidence: y_47300 (p00_pil.png): 4 pointed corners, concave top edge, centre crease. The render (e4b, e7) has round corners and a convex top.
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js pillow loft: scale the section half-width by (1 + 0.12*|2v-1|^3) toward the corners, pull the top-edge midpoint down 1.5 cm (concave), and taper the thickness to about 0.01 at the corners so they come to points.

issues.title: Pocket hems hidden behind the flap; mesh coarse; centre strap light grey instead of charcoal
issues.evidence: e6 against sans_20: the ruched dark-grey hems and the black net show directly under the grey lip. The render hem cylinders sit at y 0.084, behind the flap (bottom about 0.08). There are 8 x 4 strands of about 2 cm, and the strap is #8a8d94.
issues.fix: Hems: on(0.072, 0.03 ...), colour #4a4c52. Strands: 16 x 7 per pouch at 0.0015 width. Strap colour #2a2c31 at on(0.045, 0.025).

issues.title: Headrest cover has no leatherette sheen, and from the side it is a separate card
issues.evidence: L90/L50 1.11 (q15), against 1.6 / 2.7 in the photos. e3 shows two grey slivers off the pad wing (e3_cmp.png).
issues.fix: SEATMAT.yCover r 0.45 -> 0.32 (or LAYER.leather) so the fold catches a highlight. Extend the fold loft's last section to z -0.045 and y 0.770 so it tucks into the pad top, and add a 0.004-thick side return (gRBox 0.004 x 0.19 x 0.012) at each cover edge.

issues.title: Screen bezel near-black with a thin bottom band
issues.evidence: q18: bottom bezel 7 % of height against 11 % in y_47305. Glossy dark grey (29, 26, 38) with a lighter rim in the photo.
issues.fix: Bezel gRBox height 0.205 -> 0.215 with the glass shifted up 5 mm. Add a 3 mm #3a3944 r 0.08 rim quad around it.

issues.title: (Camera owner) q15 still not the y_47300 viewpoint, so pans, pillows and arms cannot be compared
issues.evidence: q15 frames seat backs from close and high. The y_47300 camera is about 1.5 rows back at seated head height.
issues.fix: test/qa.js q15: move the camera about 1.3 m aft and 0.25 m lower, and pitch about -6 deg.

questionsForUser: Is the fabric assignment per seat known (which backs are tick, fleck, diamond or mosaic, and which pads go with which)? The photos suggest mostly tick and fleck backs, with mosaic on pans and pads, but this cannot be confirmed from 4 photos.
Headrest height varies between photos (the cover top is about 2 cm below the back top in y_47300 and about 5.5 cm in y_47306). Should the model show the stowed or the raised headrest position?
extraRefsSearched: No new downloads. I used the local ref/ana y_47300-47306 and ref/web/econ sans_20 and sans_22.
